# Data license and provenance

Project code is licensed under the MIT License. Factual data originally
compiled by the repository maintainer and eligible for relicensing is offered
under [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).

Records derived from Liquipedia are attributed to Liquipedia contributors and
follow [CC BY-SA 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/). Each
generated record must retain its page URL, MediaWiki revision ID, and revision
timestamp.

Every player record must identify its sources. External source content,
trademarks, avatars, and database rights remain subject to their respective
terms. Recording a source URL does not relicense that source's content.

SteamIDs, in-demo names, and teams observed in match demos should retain match,
map, time, and demo-hash provenance. Only reviewed identity relationships may
enter the formal registry; conflicting observations belong in review data and
must not overwrite a confirmed mapping.
